title: Thin film coating improves solid electrolyte interface stability
abstract: A thin film coating on the solid electrolyte improves interface stability with lithium metal anodes in cell experiments.

title: Computational screening of coating materials
abstract: High throughput computation ranks coating materials; interface energies are predicted, not measured.

title: Stabilizing the lithium metal solid electrolyte interface with alloy interlayers
abstract: We show experimentally that alloy interlayers stabilize the interface between lithium metal anodes and solid electrolytes, improving cycling stability and interfacial contact in cell experiments.

title: Interface engineering for garnet electrolytes against lithium dendrite
abstract: Interface engineering of garnet solid electrolytes improves stability against lithium metal dendrite penetration; electrochemical experiments confirm stable cycling.

title: Early survey of polymer electrolytes for lithium batteries
abstract: A survey of polymer electrolyte work before solid state interfaces became central; stability concepts are historical.

title: Deep learning for urban traffic flow prediction
abstract: A deep learning model forecasts urban traffic flow; unrelated to batteries or materials.
